team.name: Raymond Shumbusho
team.bio: Raymond is the Managing Director and Founder of Global Line Safaris, a tourism company established from his passion for tourism, professional guiding and skills development within Rwanda's tourism sector. Raymond began his professional journey as a driver, where he developed a strong interest in tourism and gradually progressed into becoming a professional tourist driver-guide. Through his experience working with tourists and exploring Rwanda's destinations, he gained extensive practical knowledge of tour operations, tourist guiding, customer service, transportation and the overall tourism industry. With a growing passion for sharing his knowledge and creating opportunities for others, Raymond expanded his work beyond tourism guiding. He became actively involved in providing professional tourism training, internships and industrial attachments, helping students and aspiring tourism professionals gain practical skills and industry experience. His commitment to developing Rwanda's tourism workforce inspired him to establish Global Line Safaris, where he combines tourism services with professional skills development. Under his leadership, the company has expanded its activities to include a tourism training center accredited to offer short courses related to tourism through the Rwanda TVET Board.

team.name: Alexis Rugamba
team.bio: Alexis is a licensed tourist safari guide based in Rwanda who also leads tours across the border into Uganda. He studied tourism in high school and later earned a degree in Travel and Tourism Management. He started his career as a trainee guide at Global Line Safaris. After completing professional training, he worked as a step-on guide for city tours, countryside trips and wildlife game drives in savannah parks. After earning his degree, he was promoted from trainer and tourist guide to Operations Manager at the company. He also got his driving license and a basic mechanic certificate from Kavumu, allowing him to work as a tourist driver-guide — able to both drive and guide clients safely. He is now a certified member of the Rwanda Safari Guide Association, licensed to work as a professional safari guide.

team.name: Ismail Iradukunda
team.bio: Ismail is a tourist guide based in Rwanda, leading tours within the country. He began his career as a trainee guide at Global Line Safaris, where he trained under the company and was later hired as a full-time staff member. While working, he pursued further studies and earned a degree in Hotel and Restaurant Management, which strengthened his professional expertise in hospitality and customer service. Though now a hospitality professional by qualification, he remains passionate about the tourism industry and continues to work closely with guides and travelers. After his studies, he was promoted from trainer and tourist guide to Marketing Manager at the company. He also holds a driving license.

team.name: Diane Uwase
team.bio: Diane joined Global Line Safaris as a trainee about 1–2 years ago, straight after completing high school. Through hands-on experience and strong performance, she was promoted to Reservationist and Customer Relations, where she now manages bookings and ensures clients receive excellent service from inquiry through to the completion of their trip.

faqs.question: What does Global Line Safaris offer?
faqs.answer: Global Line Safaris offers guided wildlife safaris, historical and cultural tours, educational tours, city tours, customized tour packages, step-on guide services, car rental, accommodation booking and accredited tourism short courses and industrial attachments across Rwanda and East Africa.

faqs.question: How do I plan a trip or request a quote?
faqs.answer: Submit the Plan Your Trip form on our website with your travel dates, group size, interests and preferred package. Our team will get back to you with a tailored itinerary and quotation. You can also call or WhatsApp us on +250 793 885 400 or email info@globallinesafaris.rw.

faqs.question: Where is Global Line Safaris based?
faqs.answer: We are based on KG 7 Ave in Kigali, Rwanda. Our team operates tours across Rwanda and into neighbouring East African destinations.

faqs.question: Which destinations do you cover?
faqs.answer: We cover destinations across Rwanda including Volcanoes National Park, Akagera National Park, Nyungwe National Park, Lake Kivu, Kigali, the Congo Nile Trail and many more, as well as cross-border trips into Uganda and the wider East African region.

faqs.question: Can you arrange customized or private tours?
faqs.answer: Yes. We create personalized tour packages tailored to your interests, budget, schedule and travel preferences, and we offer private departures, car rental, step-on guides and accommodation booking to match your itinerary.

faqs.question: Do you offer training and internships in tourism?
faqs.answer: Yes. Through our tourism training center, accredited to offer short courses related to tourism through the Rwanda TVET Board, we provide professional tourism training, internships and industrial attachments for students and aspiring tourism professionals.
